set.body: The new native Results traversal at t3 does not match A11y.tabOrder(model, inside = window.paneStops) unchanged: native live plot/content stops extend the generic pane model, which expects IMAGE_VIEW when traversal reaches a PARENT plot host. A11yTreeSuite walks Compare query layout; its existing t3 case audits names/roles only. This tranche adds an actual full-cycle Results Tab golden and verifies one Participants stop, labelled nodes and return to the project chip. Follow-up: audit exact full native focus tree against DESIGN_SPEC section10 (one stop per plot), determine any redundant outer-pane stops, model every live Results control/plot/table stop in portable app data, and bind the native hierarchy to that contract. Test exact derived-vs-walked forward/backward traversal at t3 in light/dark, retaining row cursor announcements and F6 behavior. Do not hide unexplained stops or treat native-role introspection as portable derivation. The actual traversal golden is regression evidence, not a claim that this pure derivation gap is already fixed.
set.title: Results: reconcile complete Tab-order derivation with live plot/table contents
